caption: A marshmallow in a microwave swells to several times its size and then collapses when the door opens.

sa.check: A marshmallow sits in a microwave.
The marshmallow grows to several times its size.
The marshmallow collapses into a sticky blob.
The swelling comes first and the collapse follows.

pc.expect: The marshmallow only swells while the microwave runs and only collapses after the heat stops; it does not swell again with the door open.
pc.fail: The marshmallow shrinks while the microwave still runs; or it swells again after the door is open with nothing running; or the swelling and collapsing repeat with the door open; or it collapses before the door has moved.

pc.expect: The marshmallow stays one mass of foam as it swells, its surface stretching, and it slumps into a lower wider blob when it collapses.
pc.fail: The marshmallow keeps its sharp cylinder edges while several times its size; or it swells into a smooth sphere with a hard shell; or it splits into separate marshmallows as it swells; or it turns into another object.

pc.expect: The swollen marshmallow slumps downward when it collapses and stays on the plate.
pc.fail: The marshmallow lifts off the plate as it swells and hangs in the air; or it collapses upward into a tall spike; or it rises when the door opens; or it slumps sideways off the plate with nothing pushing it.

pc.expect: The marshmallow behaves as a softening foam: it stretches, goes glossy and stays sticky and slack after collapsing.
pc.fail: The marshmallow shatters when it collapses; or snaps back to its first firm shape; or runs off the plate as a thin liquid; or bounces on the plate like rubber.

pc.expect: One marshmallow on one plate in one microwave; it swells and slumps rather than appearing or vanishing.
pc.fail: A second marshmallow appears; or the marshmallow vanishes; or it passes through the plate; or it passes through the microwave's door.

pc.expect: The plate, the microwave's interior and the marshmallow's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The plate's pattern changes; or the interior changes; or the marshmallow changes colour.

note: Browning of the marshmallow is chemistry and is not judged.
